subtitle: Tiny games. Total chaos.
promotionalText: 33 tiny games, a few seconds each. Read the word, do the thing, and hang on as it speeds up every five games.
description:
Micro Mayhem is a frantic run of 33 tiny games. Each one flashes a single instruction and gives you a few seconds to do it.

POP IT. SWAT IT. FLIP IT. LASSO IT. DON'T TOUCH!

Read the word, work out what to do, and do it before the fuse burns down. Win and you're straight into the next one. Miss and you lose a heart. Every five games, the whole thing speeds up.

• 33 microgames, each with its own look and its own gesture
• Tap, swipe, drag, draw loops, hold, tilt and shake
• Speeds up every five games, so every run gets more chaotic
• Four lives per run
• Game Center leaderboard for your best score
• Haptics on every pop, squish and slam
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking

How far can you get before it all falls apart?
